         <div class="hc-progress-track" role="progressbar" aria-label="_Float16 (f16) precision support" aria-valuenow="18.2" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" style="background: var(--hc-track-bg); border-radius: 3px; height: 5px; overflow: hidden;"><div class="hc-progress-fill" style="background: var(--hc-purple-bar); width: 18.2%; height: 100%;"></div></div>
       </div>
       <div style="background: var(--color-background-primary, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--color-background-border, #e1e4e8); border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px;">
         <div style="font-size: 0.8em; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-foreground-muted, #6c757d);">_Float128 (f128)</div>
         <div style="font-size: 1.05em; font-weight: 700; margin: 2px 0;">4 / 22 <span style="font-size: 0.75em; color: var(--hc-purple-text);">(18.2%)</span></div>

```
